facts.why: The plot has a diner where two cops and the waitress are killed, but the pages I opened never name it. I could not confirm Spring & Crosby as the diner's name.

facts.text: the Reverend's shelter on the Bowery
facts.why: The Reverend runs the local homeless shelter. No source I opened places it on the Bowery, and the card itself puts the neighbourhood in SoHo.
facts.fix: the Reverend's shelter, ready for dunking into the stew

facts.text: Greenwich Village cider doughnuts -- the Village above the sewers
facts.why: The card sets the coffee shop in SoHo and the film names no Village location in any source I opened. The phrase also contradicts the printed map.
facts.fix: SoHo cider doughnuts -- SoHo above the sewers

vibe.verdict: A coffee shop with a sewer map is a clever idea and looks great, but the film's best bits are barely used.
